race.description: Batemans Bay Soldiers Club Mdn Plate
race.comment: BOUJEE GOLD (10) only warmed into it late when resuming over 1200m at Goulburn. Plenty of scope for improvement over the added trip and is a great chance to break through. HARD YARDS (3) went better than the form guide reads on debut and will take a lot from the hitout. Worth following up. LAUREATA (11) was fair on debut last time out when fourth over 1210m at Sapphire Coast. Should appreciate the extra ground. In the mix. BELLEISTIC BONNY (7) has been less effective in her last two starts but remains in the mix.
